3. Optimized Kelly and No.2's character performance

notes.title: V1.00202209261100 Updates
notes.content:
1. Super Alloy Ranger now supports Steam Cloud.
2. Modified the configuration details of some levels.
3. Fixed some configuration errors in Ultimate War.
4. Fixed the wrong performance of some Boss.

How to find the lost savedata

Please follow the guide below to retrieve the savedata.
If you enter the game after the update, and find the savedata is empty
1. Please enter the following path: 
C:\Users\Administrator\AppData\LocalLow\AlloyMushroom\Super.Alloy.Ranger 
Find the directory which consists of number strings.

2. Copy the contents of that directory to
C:\Users\Administrator\AppData\LocalLow\AlloyMushroom\Super_Alloy_Ranger 
under the path of the same name and overwrite it.

We are working on solve the problem, apologize for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Super Alloy Ranger Patch1.00202209222000
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294439/69b526fccc47fe9d99645a8d711f519c5cc720d5.jpg[/img]
1. Fixed the bug that the current blood and score may be load incorrectly when a player is defeated in Ultimate War and chooses to continue.
2. Fixed the wrong status of some enemies.
3. Changed the refresh mechanism of the boxes in Ultimate Fortress to prevent lagging.
4. Forecast: Steam Cloud will be supported from next week. Please stay tuned with us!
5. Adjusted the performance of some enemies in different difficulties.

*The game has started its program refactoring process by a new senior programmer. After the completion of the program refactoring, the game will support Linux and mac systems, and the achievement system. At the same time, the basic physics bugs and lags will also be solved after the refactoring.
I will continue to patch the existing version while the refactoring is ongoing.

*The refactoring is expected to take 1~2 months.

*Sorry for the problems caused by my inexperience in programming. It will take some time to improve existing issues. Thank you for all of your support!

notes.title: V1.00202209202000 Updates
notes.content:
1. Fixed the bug that the character would be forced down when sent to the corner by the conveyor belt.
2. Modified the time requirement value of the evaluation system.
3. Modified some data configuration.

notes.title: V1.00202209192000 Updates
notes.content:
1. Fixed the situation of insufficient energy pieces in the sprint training level.
2. Adjusted the value of weak weapons. Now Kerry's power is stronger.
3. Adjusted the configuration of the hidden route. Now you can find more clues.

notes.title: V1.00202209182000 Updates
notes.content:
1. Fixed the problem of wrong enemy blood value in some levels.
2. Reduced the difficulty of some bosses.
3. Extended the calm period of plasma storm.
4. Fixed the problem that the keypad on 108 keyboard could not be applied properly to the options.
5. Fixed the timing error that may occur when choosing to continue the game in Ultimate War.

notes.title: V1.00202209172000 update
notes.content:
1. Modified the position of the confirmation and cancel keys of the controller. Sorry for the inconvenience!
2. The controller key names are now the same as the XBOX controller key.
3. Fixed the wrong performance of some BOSS on some computer configurations.
4. More kinds of window sizes are supported in the Options.
5. Fixed some wrong play logic of some sound effects.
6. More keyboard keys are now be supported as custom keys.
7. Fixed the wrong performance when No.02 launching a shooting ExAttack on a wall.
8: Fixed some wrong character state.

notes.title: V1.00202209162000 Updates
notes.content:
1. Fixed some of the wrong settings of Zero-Dimensional Metropolis on normal difficulty.
2. Fixed the background music play of the prologue episode.
3. Fixed the problem that some characters may perform wrong moves in certain situations.

notes.title: V1.00202209152000 Updates
notes.content:
1. The ALT+ENTER hotkeys have been disabled because of the bug it may triggered. Please switch between fullscreen and window mode via "Options - Display".
2. Fixed the problem that some enemies may respawned at wrong positions.
3. Fixed some wrong mechanism data.
4. Fixed some wrong level configuration.
5. Fixed the situation that the level evaluation may be abnormal if the clearance time exceeded 1 hour.
